title: Angara highlights PH school feeding program at SEA School Meals Summit
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara showcased the Philippines’ expanded school feeding initiatives at the opening of the 2nd Southeast Asia Regional School Meals Coalition Summit…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara showcased the Philippines’ expanded school feeding initiatives at the opening of the 2nd Southeast Asia Regional School Meals Coalition Summit on Monday, emphasizing that investing in learner nutrition improves health, boosts classroom performance, and builds a stronger future for the region. In his keynote address before regional education ministers, senior government officials, development partners, international organization representatives, and civil society leaders, Angara underscored the country’s commitment to ensuring no child is left behind due to hunger, adding that providing nutritious meals in schools remains one of the most effective long-term investments a nation can […]...
